description: PRIM answered 429 (too many requests). The server makes no PRIM call for 1 hour, for any stop. The request is at 2026-10-02T08:30:00Z. retryAt is 1 hour later, plus 0 to 59 seconds that depend on the stop and on the end of the pause (44 s for this stop here), so that the apps of different stops do not all ask at the same second.
